provenance: CARL-PROG-01 CP-A (docs/03-tech/carl-prog-01-floor01-combat-progression.md section 3, CP-Q01..CP-Q11, CP-Q44..CP-Q46). Generic and IP-neutral: capability ids, slots and trigger ids are engine data; the display and notice fields are the fan-layer text. Adopted defaults, not approved balance. K1 (f01 integration plan #182, adopted over CP-Q01 Revision 2): the thrown charge is granted on the Hoarder's defeat, trigger `pile_boss_f01_defeated`. Until the Hoarder exists (HRD-A) it is a PLACEHOLDER zone trigger over a stub rectangle that no scene arms (the same stub the earlier find zone was), and it becomes an event trigger later through an additive event matcher (a generic `EnemyDefeated` match with a `target`) and a Hoarder scene kind, both owned by HRD-A2; the ledger mechanism does not change. DONUT-PROG-01 DP-A (docs/03-tech/donut-prog-01-floor01-ability-progression.md, DP-Q02, DP-Q03, DP-Q06, DP-Q07, DP-Q09, DP-Q10, DP-Q12): Donut's rows (jump_reach_boost, special_short_blink) carry hero 1 and a requires list (story order as data), the zone trigger f01_safe_room_reward_found is a PLACEHOLDER zone in the story corridor run (a stand-in for the I-08 refuge reward, 640 px past the guild zone; the real refuge pickup replaces it later), special_short_blink is the second entry of the single Juicer grants list (no second trigger), and a donut_prog story flag enables hero 1 only. A trigger is armed when any entry of its grants list belongs to an enabled program; each entry is granted only if its program is enabled and its requires are held. PT-SCENE (docs/07-agents/f01-playtest-integration-plan.md section 4.7, K1, K9, KR12): the room pins of `--scene f01_late` are pin rows with scene `f01_late`, chosen by id and carrying one row per story flag. `f01_pin_pre_pile_boss` (the Hoarder room: Light on Your Feet, provisional K9, the biscuit being a read-through) and `f01_pin_post_pile_boss` (every room after the Hoarder: dynamite, K1, and Light on Your Feet) are the pins the encounter sidecars name; `f01_late_mastery` (the mastery arena) holds every capability. A room pin never holds a capability whose grant point comes later in the static story order (the order test of src/f01_late.rs).
